name: Oath of the Crown
summary: Paladins sworn to the ideals of civilization and the law.

features.name: Oath Spells
features.short: Oath spells that are always prepared for free.
features.summary: You always have your oath spells prepared once you reach the listed paladin levels. They don't count against the number of spells you prepare.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Champion Challenge
features.short: Force creatures within 30 ft. to stay near you.
features.summary: As a bonus action, each creature of your choice within 30 ft. makes a WIS save or can't willingly move more than 30 ft. away from you.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Turn the Tide
features.short: Bonus action: heal allies at half HP or less.
features.summary: As a bonus action, each creature of your choice within 30 ft. that can hear you and has no more than half its hit points regains 1d6 + CHA hit points.

features.name: Divine Allegiance
features.short: Reaction: take the damage meant for an adjacent ally.
features.summary: When a creature within 5 ft. takes damage, you can use your reaction to take that damage instead.

features.name: Unyielding Spirit
features.short: Advantage on saves against paralysis and stun.
features.summary: You have advantage on saving throws to avoid becoming paralyzed or stunned.

features.name: Exalted Champion
features.short: Resist physical damage; allies gain advantage on death and WIS saves.
features.summary: As an action, for 1 hour you have resistance to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing and slashing, and you and allies within 30 ft. have advantage on death saves and WIS saves. Once per long rest.
